label: Some-removal retained capacity interpretation
definition: Every historical edge has an actually exercising later member at baseline; some admissible post-production/use removal leaves its capacity enabled. Quantification covers both generation and instrument histories on the supplied profile.
note: Explicit analyst sibling of DEF-PER-ACCIDENS-ORDERED-SERIES, not its settled identity or source attribution. Uses Post-production removal profile for task state and admissibility. Universal versions do not assert nonempty admissible domains; existential versions do. Actual exercise entails capacity by the execution certificate in State; capacity alone does not entail an execution. No accessibility, metaphysical possibility, or exhaustive source interpretation is asserted.
